gpu_admission: No unknown/model/training process on target GPU; allow identified other parent/child Kit auxiliary context<=512MiB with exact PID/main-device binding; free>=70GiB for a new simulator before model loading.
second_gate_dependency: After first H22 gate and child first native2575671 exit; avoid concurrent Kit initialization/control contention without extending either live budget.
hypothesis: Exclude actual current robot visual-link points before rigid scene odometry, retaining all quality thresholds, to remove self-motion pollution seen in H21.
other_gpus: GPU0/1 teammates; GPU3 SFT child; no interruption
cache_policy: New parent-only NVMe OG appdata/cache plus all temporary/CUDA/shader/Torch/HF cache variables redirected before process import. Sequential parent simulator runs reuse this same own software appdata; never share with child or teammates. No scene-state restore or source changes. Precreate only new screenshots directory readable. Installed OG still copies two small kit/logo files within EXP_PATH; SDA not fully readonly. Complete scandir and mounts checked before each start and periodic monitoring; monitoring caps are cooperative, not atomic byte reservations.
flags: All H21 flags unchanged plus --odometry-self-exclusion; rgbd_joint/fixed6; no threshold relaxation or recovery expansion
policy_prerequisites: All saved chains and original image evidence inspected
Model revision/source/overlays/service identity and actual resources checked
comparison: Same source task/model/action-time budgets as H21; new generated plan/rendering may differ, so development comparison not randomized A/B or heldout success rate.
stop: First safety/quality failure not covered by unchanged SEARCH recovery, official termination, registered time/control/model/storage budget. No automatic extra reset. On external storage limit attempt one SIGINT graceful safety hold, never relabel interrupted run successful. Archive before stopping own idle service.
